<b>Winged Pilgrims</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are bugs with a short horn and born with small wings that cannot carry them far.<ref>Winged Pilgrim [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Short-horned bug born with underdeveloped wings. Flight it possesses, but only just. It may lift from the stone, but those sad wings would never carry it far."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Winged Pilgrims either start off resting on a platform or flying idly back and forth.<br>
In either case, once they have spotted Hornet, they try to maintain distance from her whilst flying. They then try to line themselves up with Hornet horizontally and point their horn at her before flying at her, stopping after a certain distance has been travelled.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Winged Pilgrims have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Winged Pilgrims can be found in many lower areas of [[Pharloom]]: in [[the Marrow]], in [[Far Fields]] to the east of the [[Seamstress]], outside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]] in [[Bone Bottom]], and in the vertical shaft rooms of [[Shellwood]] and [[Wormways]].

They can also be found inside the [[Chapel of the Wanderer]]'s arena.

During [[Act 3]], one will spawn in [[Lumble the Lucky]]'s room in [[Blasted Steps]] alongside a [[Pilgrim Hiker]] and an [[Elder Pilgrim]] before <i>[[Hero's Call]]</i>. Another will spawn with a [[Void Mass]] and disappear once the mass is killed. Winged Pilgrims can also be seen fighting [[Shakra]] at the [[Shellwood]] and [[Greymoor]] entrances to [[Bellhart]].
